name: cpu
_doc: THE CPU BAND — 'is a no-dGPU box usable for writing?'
Every leg is pure CPU (nGpuLayers 0 forces it even on the CUDA build). The GPU
bar is NOT re-run here: `baselineRefs` recalls gpu-gemma-26b's stored result
into the table, so a CPU run never spends time re-measuring the GPU.
(Run the GPU band once first, or that row shows as 'never run'.)
Feature set is deliberately SHORT-CONTEXT: the recipe's own guidance is that
long-prompt work (chat-with-book at 8k, sweeps) is decided separately by the
pp8192 row, and an uncapped sweep on a slow CPU leg is hours of wall clock.
Threads = 8 = the physical cores of this box (Ryzen 7 5700X). Change it if the
box changes. Downloads: only gemma-4-26b-a4b-qat is on disk today; the other
legs fetch their weights on first load (allowed a 4h ceiling).

chat.question: What is this book about, and who is the protagonist?

characterChat.question: What do you want most right now, and what are you afraid of?

legs.label: 26B-A4B MoE, pure CPU — the A4B class (recipe leg B)
legs._why: Weights already on disk, so this is the CPU datapoint available with zero downloads. Same model as the GPU baseline, which makes the GPU-vs-CPU delta a clean single-variable comparison.

legs.label: Dense 12B QAT, pure CPU — the dense control (recipe leg C)
legs._why: What the Google answer recommended, and the only catalog chat model that fits a 16 GB-RAM laptop (~6.7 GB). Needs a download.

legs.label: Ternary Bonsai 27B, pure CPU — a model DESIGNED for CPU (recipe leg E)
_why: Ternary weights, ~7.6 GB, built for CPU rather than squeezed onto it — the one
leg that could beat the general-purpose models on this band's own terms.
⚠ BEFORE THIS LEG CAN RUN — it is NOT in the catalog. Smart Add it from HF:
Then set `model` below to whatever catalog id the Smart Add creates.
⚠ `quant` IS PINNED ON PURPOSE. The repo also ships an F16 (53.8 GB); without
the quant filter the GGUF resolver takes the largest file and llama-bench would
⚠ ONLY the g64 file runs on mainline llama.cpp, and only on CPU/Metal — Q2_0
needs the PrismML fork, so there is no GPU leg for this model on our engine.
⚠ KNOWN RISK, verified 2026-07-19: HF discussion #3 reports this exact file
failing to load — "tensor 'output_norm.weight' has offset 357580800, expected
337715200" — on both mainline and the fork. Unclear whether it was re-uploaded
since. Users there also report only ~1-2 tok/s on CPU. If it fails, the bench
records a load failure naming the model rather than producing junk.

legs.label: 35B-A3B MoE, pure CPU — smallest active params (recipe leg A)
legs._why: Best-case CPU generation in the catalog (A3.6B active). Needs ~24 GB free RAM and a ~23 GB download — 32 GB box only.
